comment: Measured on 4 Nov 2026 on Linux: start about 2 s and 30.6 MB, first round +2.9 MB, second round +0.0 MB. Raise a limit only on purpose, in the same pull request as the change that needs it, saying why. 11 Nov 2026: the start limit went from 36 to 37 MB. Giving the small text sizes names (Styles/Sizes.axaml), so a style can change them, costs about 0.7 MB at start (35.8 to 36.5 MB): each of the sidebar's and Overview's small texts now follows its name instead of holding a typed number. Pages opened later cost no more than before. 12 Nov 2026: the start limit went from 37 to 38 MB. A new install now shows the day, the timer, chat and a clock beside the dock, which costs about 0.9 MB at start (36.4 to 37.3 MB) after the dock's menus and group lists were made to build only when asked for; with nothing beside the dock it costs nothing. 17 Nov 2026: the start limit went from 38 to 39 MB. Notifications are kept under a bell in the sidebar (both its wide and folded forms, about 0.2 MB) and every Needs you line can be dismissed, so the line's one button for taking it off now shows on every line, not only on mail (about 0.3 MB): 37.8 to 38.4 MB. To keep it to that, Today's Done and Dismiss add no parts to a row (the list takes the click on the row's own label; a button per row cost 20 MB with 199 things on a day) and the bell's list is built when first opened.
